title: Social Stratification: Comparing Groups and Figures
goal: I can compare groups and figures (*arányában*, *viszonylatában*, *tekintetében*).
I can talk about social layers and inequality (*társadalmi olló*, *státuszkongruencia*, *jövedelmi polarizáció*).
I can say how one thing changes in proportion to another.

sections.title: Unit 19: Social Stratification
body: This unit is about how Hungarian society is layered: income gaps, history of social groups, poverty, school selection and social mobility.

You will compare figures with formal postpositions, use *-va/-ve* participles in history texts, stress small numbers, name results, and measure change with scalar adverbs. The unit ends with a short text about Erdei Ferenc's picture of Hungarian society.
